description: Potential null pointer dereference from foreign function
rationale: C functions may return null; must check before deref

description: Struct layout mismatch between MAGE and foreign type
rationale: ABI incompatibility; use #[repr(C)]

description: Foreign-allocated memory not freed
rationale: C allocations need explicit free(); Rust Drop won't fire

description: C string missing NUL terminator
rationale: C expects NUL-terminated strings

description: Foreign string may not be valid UTF-8
rationale: Rust strings require valid UTF-8

description: Function missing extern "C" ABI declaration
rationale: Default Rust ABI is incompatible with C

description: Opaque foreign types should be modeled as extern type or non-constructable struct
rationale: Prevents accidental construction or size assumptions

description: Panic across FFI boundary is undefined behavior
rationale: Panics must be caught before returning to C

description: Type alignment may differ between Rust and C
rationale: Misaligned access is UB on some platforms

description: Reference passed to C code — aliasing rules cannot be enforced
rationale: C code may alias or store the pointer beyond borrow scope
fix_template: Pass raw pointer instead if C stores it

description: Enum without defined repr has unstable discriminant values
rationale: FFI enums need #[repr(C)] or #[repr(i32)]

description: Rust bool is 1 byte; C _Bool may differ
rationale: Use c_int or c_char for FFI booleans
fix_template: Replace bool with c_int in FFI signatures

description: C size_t maps to Rust usize; ensure target compatibility
rationale: Both are pointer-sized on the target platform

description: Variadic C functions are inherently unsafe
rationale: No type checking on variadic arguments

description: C library may have global mutable state
rationale: Thread-safety depends on the C library's guarantees
fix_template: Synchronize access or verify C library thread-safety

description: WASM imports use extern "C" with #[link(wasm_import_module)]
rationale: WebAssembly host functions require specific linking

description: Use bindgen to auto-generate FFI bindings from C headers
rationale: Reduces manual binding errors

description: Use cbindgen to generate C headers from Rust code
rationale: Ensures C consumers have correct declarations

description: Pinned types should not be passed across FFI — C doesn't understand Pin
rationale: C code may move the value
fix_template: Unpin before passing to C, or use raw pointer

description: Use explicit error codes instead of Result across FFI
rationale: C doesn't have Result; use int return + out-parameter
fix_template: Return c_int error code and pass result via out-pointer
